rules.build:
export XML_CONFIG="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/xml2-config" export LIBGCRYPT_CONFIG="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/libgcrypt-config"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR"
"$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-silent-rules \ --with-history \ --with-icu \ --without-python
# HACK: this fixes a problem with lib path detection if [ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" != "/tools" ]; then find . -name "Makefile" -exec sed -i 's@-L/tools/lib@-L/usr/lib@g' '{}' ';' fi
make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS"
